# Private Solve 4 wheels

Create a `wheels/` subdirectory here and place the authorised private Solve 4
wheel files there before using Solve-dependent features:

- `wheels/libsolve-1.0.11-py3-none-any.whl`
- `wheels/solve_cli-1.0.14-py3-none-any.whl`

These files are not included in this repository and must not be committed or
redistributed. See the main [README](../README.md) for details.
